deep_analysis:
PORTFOLIO: 0 open trades, flat. In a SHORT_BIAS market with BTC below EMA300 for 4+ hours, flat is the correct position. No exposure = no wrong-side risk.

REGIME: BTC 15m SHORT_BIAS, 4h SHORT_BIAS, continuum BELOW EMA300 (consecutive_below=245 min). Linreg LEAN_BEAR. Market-wide scan: 52 tokens SHORT_BIAS vs only 2 LONG_BIAS (TON, COMP) and 72 NEUTRAL. Volatility LOW. This is a bear/chop regime — every LONG is fighting the trend.

THE LOSING PATTERN (last 20 trades, 35% WR, -0.41 USDT):
LONGs: 3/13 wins (23% WR). SHORTs: 4/7 wins (57% WR).
The regime was telling us to short. We longed. The money went to the short side.

LONG losers clustered at two RSI zones:
- RSI 57-64 (longing into strength during downtrend): INJ -4.44%, BLUR -2.70%, BANANA -2.24%, IO -2.11%. These are the worst losses — buying tops in a falling market.
- RSI 33-52 (longing weakness, expecting bounce): APT -4.24%, ETC -4.13%, WLD -0.70%, LDO -0.21%, HYPE -0.39%. Oversold longs in a downtrend keep falling.

SHORT winners came from mid-band RSI 54-63: HBAR +3.29% (RSI 54.5), ALT +4.22% (RSI 63.3).
SHORT losers came from oversold RSI 38-41: HYPE -1.32% (RSI 38.1), ETH -1.72% (RSI 40.7). Shorting into oversold = wrong side.

THE WINNING SIDE: SHORTS at RSI 50-63 in a SHORT_BIAS regime. We have the data — HBAR and ALT proved it. The signals are correct when aligned with regime. The problem is the LONG signals (pump-chain+, bb-bounce-v2-long, ai-trader+) keep firing longs in a bear market.

SIGNAL PERFORMANCE RED FLAGS:
- pump-chain+ (LONG): 3-loss streak, -0.27 USDT. Long signal in short regime.
- ai-trader+ (LONG): 3-loss streak, -0.63 USDT total. Same issue.
- volume-breakout-long+: 17 trades, 17.6% WR, -1.03 USDT. Worst signal by total PnL.
- bb-bounce-v2-long+: 28 trades, 46.4% WR, -0.37 USDT. High volume, negative returns.
- ai-trader-manual BTC trades: 4 trades, 2 wins 1 loss 1 scratch, net positive. BTC is the easiest to direction-call.

VACATION GUARDRAIL ACTIVE: 7d WR 33.7% < 35%, position size reduced to 30%. Correct — protect capital while the streak is cold.

pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED PATTERN 1: Counter-trend LONGs in SHORT_BIAS regime (n=13, WR 23%, avg -0.14% per trade)
Last 20 trades: 13 LONGs won only 3. LONGs at RSI 57-64 lost most: INJ -4.44% (RSI 64), BLUR -2.70% (RSI 62.5), BANANA -2.24% (RSI 58.3), IO -2.11% (RSI 57.1). LONGs at RSI 33-52 also lost: APT -4.24% (RSI 33.7), ETC -4.13% (RSI 50). WINNING SIDE: the shorts that same hour. BTC dropped from ~81500 to 81100 while we held longs. SAND, GRASS, ZRO all dropped 2-4% while we bought. WHY WEREN'T WE ON IT? pump-chain+ and bb-bounce-v2-long are LONG-only signals. They fire regardless of regime. Their 3-loss streaks are the cost.

VERIFIED PATTERN 2: SHORT at oversold RSI < 42 loses (n=2, WR 0%, avg -1.52% per trade)
HYPE SHORT at RSI 38.1 lost -1.32%. ETH SHORT at RSI 40.7 lost -1.72%. WINNING SIDE: the longs that bought the oversold dip. SHORT_RSI_HARD_FLOOR=45 exists for this reason. These trades should have been blocked or flipped LONG. Note: ETH at 40.7 is suspiciously close to the floor — may indicate a stale entry_rsi_14 (DRIFT-E). meta_rsi says 40.7.

VERIFIED PATTERN 3: SHORT at mid-band RSI 54-63 wins (n=2, WR 100%, avg +3.76% per trade)
HBAR SHORT at RSI 54.5 won +3.29%. ALT SHORT at RSI 63.3 won +4.22%. This is the sweet spot: shorting into strength while the regime is SHORT_BIAS. The pump-chain- (SHORT) signal works when RSI is in the middle of the band, not at extremes.

RECOMMENDATION: AI Trader should only fire SHORT signals until BTC reclaims EMA300. LONG signals (pump-chain+, ai-trader+, bb-bounce-v2-long) will keep bleeding in this regime. The 30% vacation guardrail size cap is the right brake — keep it until 7d WR recovers above 35%.
